# DataForSEO Gemini Search Answer API

Get Gemini's answer to a query as a signed-out user would see it.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/ai_optimization/gemini/llm_scraper/live/advanced` task schema (one task per call; send `{"tasks": [...]}` for several). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/ai_optimization/gemini/llm_scraper/live/advanced" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"keyword": "best running shoes 2026", "location_code": 2840, "language_code": "en"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint (one task per call). Fields used above:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `keyword` | Search query. |
| `location_code` | Location code, e.g. 2840 for the United States. |
| `language_code` | Language code, e.g. "en". |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/ai_optimization/gemini/llm_scraper/live/advanced/

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
